# Commands

[Documentation](../README.md#documentation)

<!-- Generated by just docs-commands; do not edit. -->

```text
Usage: prep <command> [args] [--json] [--root dir | --project name] [--by actor]

Read commands:
  prime [--max N]            session-start briefing: parents, actionable count, alerts
  hook session-start|prompt|finish|before-tool|after-tool [--harness claude-code|codex] [--plugin path]  shared lifecycle hooks (event JSON on stdin)
  guide <id>                 step contract: state, transitions, unmet gates, inputs, outputs
  brief <id> [--check] [--out [file]]  hand-off text for an implementer (--check: a checker) that needs no prep: requirement, context, criteria, decisions, rules, report format; --out writes it to a file (default .prep/local/handoff/<id>/) and prints the path
  list [query flags]         query issues: --state --kind --tag --priority --under --stale --actionable --blocked --parent --leaf --top --text --tree --view --max N; not-<value> negates (--state not-open)
  next [--under <id>]        actionable issues: ready, not stale, dependencies done, unclaimed
  show <id>                  read one issue with its derived state
  check                      validate the whole tree
  activity [--max N] [--actor a] [--all]  what agents did with prep, newest last (local, per machine; --all includes the archived streams); activity add: harness events as JSON lines on stdin; activity report [--since <date>]: the recorded sessions summed up: hook outcomes, rule following, hand-offs, commands with failures by error code, and the cost harnesses reported (--since counts from that date on and includes the archives)
  flags                      every query flag with the values it accepts now and their issue counts
  knowledge list|find|show  read knowledge entries
  views                      saved views from config.yaml (else config.yaml.dist)
  projects [add <dir> | remove <dir|name|id>]  prep projects on this machine, most recently used first (recorded by every command run in one): name, ID suffix, last use, root, remote
  tui [--agent|--gallery]    terminal UI next to the harness (--agent: open on what the agent is doing; --gallery: every component, t/T switch themes)
  cloud script              print the cloud environment setup script for this version (paste it into the environment dialog)
  eval run|list|doctor|report|compare|models|errors|check|judge-check|prune|clean  agent behavior tests: run prompts against fake projects and report how agents used prep (see the eval knowledge entry)
  skill                      print the agent skill (static copy for environments without the binary)
  version                    print the version

Write commands:
  init                      create .prep with an empty knowledge base
  new --title T --kind K     create an issue [--parent id] [--depends-on id]... [--tag t]... [--priority p] [--body text | --body-file path|-]
  edit <id>                  change [--title T] [--kind K] [--parent id|''] [--depends-on id|'']... [--tag t|'']... [--priority p] [--body text | --body-file path|-]
  context <id>               replace the implementation context: --body text | --body-file path|-
  decide [<id>] --title T --description D  requires an issue, --scope <glob> or --project-wide; [--supersedes <record>] [--outcome]
  criterion <id>             acceptance criteria: --add text, --check n, --uncheck n, --remove n (repeatable)
  dod --add|--remove <item>  edit the project Definition of Done guidance
  finding [<id>] --title T --description D  write a finding record [--scope <glob>]
  log <id> <text>            append a line to the work log
  handback <id> [--check] [--report file|-] [--commit hash]  write a brief's report into linked knowledge and logs; checker and research reports require Criteria verdicts, check met criteria and complete when all are met and Problems is empty, otherwise log failures and leave in progress; research reports write findings without --check; default .prep/local/handoff/<id>/report.md (check-report.md with --check); successful reports move to *.done.md
  handoff start <id>... [--yes] | fetch [--merge]  start Claude Code cloud sessions or fetch their branches; never pushes
  focus <id> | --clear        set or clear the issue you work on, for prep tui's Agent view (local; writes no records)
  define <id> [--trivial]    write a requirement baseline (open questions must be empty); --trivial re-baselines a stale issue's trivial change, enrichment stays valid
  ready <id> [--note]        sign off enrichment against the newest baseline
  claim <id> [--note]        start work
  release <id> [--reason]    stop work without finishing
  complete <id>              finish: [--commit <hash>] [--note]
  reopen <id> --reason <text> reopen a done issue: its resolution moves to the work log
  drop <id> --reason <text>  drop an issue in any unresolved state
  fmt [--check]              rewrite files in canonical format (--check: report only, exit 1 on changes)
  fix                        safe auto-fixes from check
  setup [--harness h,...|--remove h|--refresh]  install harness integrations (skill, hooks, commands)
  update [--check]           replace this binary with the latest release (verifies its checksum)

--project (or PREP_PROJECT) runs a command in another prep project on this machine: a name, ID, remote or path from prep projects.

IDs accept any unique suffix. --by (or PREP_ACTOR) names the actor: <producer>/<version> for agents, human:<id> for people.
```
